name: gilbert
description: Gilbert — an enterprise butler for Stalwart: agents that work your mail and files, on a first-class JMAP mail client

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w web && npm run test -w server
scripts.prepush: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run adr:owed && npm run adr:cite && npm run config:dead && npm run workflow:pin && npm run i18n:check && TZ=UTC npm test
scripts.prepush:full: npm run prepush && npm run codeql
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n mock,server,web -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm run mock -w server" "GILBERT_AGENT_ADDRESS=gilbert@example.com GILBERT_AGENT_PASSWORD=gilbert-password STALWART_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8788 npm run dev -w server" "VITE_PHONE_MOCK=1 npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:mock:no-future-release: concurrently -n mock,server,web -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm run mock:no-future-release -w server" "GILBERT_AGENT_ADDRESS=gilbert@example.com GILBERT_AGENT_PASSWORD=gilbert-password STALWART_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8788 npm run dev -w server" "VITE_PHONE_MOCK=1 npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:mock:no-keyword-sort: concurrently -n mock,server,web -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm run mock:no-keyword-sort -w server" "GILBERT_AGENT_ADDRESS=gilbert@example.com GILBERT_AGENT_PASSWORD=gilbert-password STALWART_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8788 npm run dev -w server" "VITE_PHONE_MOCK=1 npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:mock:agent: concurrently -n mock,server,agent,web -c yellow,blue,green,magenta "MOCK_AGENT_ADDRESS=gilbert@example.com MOCK_AGENT_PASSWORD=gilbert-password npm run mock -w server" "GILBERT_AGENT_ADDRESS=gilbert@example.com GILBERT_AGENT_PASSWORD=gilbert-password STALWART_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8788 npm run dev -w server" "GILBERT_AGENT_ADDRESS=gilbert@example.com GILBERT_AGENT_PASSWORD=gilbert-password STALWART_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8788 npm run agent -w server" "VITE_PHONE_MOCK=1 npm run dev -w web"
